title: althaea officinalis subsp. taurinensis
intro: Althaea officinalis subsp. taurinensis, commonly known as Marsh Mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and providing relief from respiratory problems such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Mallow are attributed to its demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and soothing properties, which can help protect and calm irritated mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Mallow include mucilages, flavonoids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
